title: the record a connector archived
line: a real connector's run goes through the runner with only the network call played back from real responses: a gravesite page listing five decedents is archived as the record and the matcher proposes the one who is the person; the death index's rows under a surname are archived as a derivative, byte for byte the archive's own, and the one that fits is proposed; a census household's transcription, its page image refused, is the record, and the other members' steps are logged against the same page

steps.say: the gravesite step on Raymond Earl Davidson, run through the real gravesite connector, the locator's own response to his search played back

expect.why: the page is the record: read, matched, and the run found
the record archived is the archive's own object, byte for byte
kept under the locator's holder, the search as its identity
five decedents are listed and one card is put up: Raymond E, born 12 Oct 1939, died 27 Jan 2007, to the Raymond Earl of the tree; the other four fit nobody
one run logged under the connector's source, the record on it
a fetch step is done by its holder's answer

steps.say: the gravesite step on Noi Davidson, the page listing the one decedent of that name

expect.why: Noi, born 15 Jan 1929, died 12 Nov 2015, proposed to the Noi of the tree

steps.say: the death record the file cites for Frederick Micheal Ahearn Jr, a fetch step at the New Jersey index's holder, run through the real death index connector: the file's lines played back

expect.why: the 31 rows under Ahearn are the record, read and matched, and the run found
the derivative the runner computes from the file's lines is the very object the live archive holds for Ahearn's rows, byte for byte
of the 31 Ahearns the index lists, the one born 6 Nov 1932 at Coatesville, died 3 Apr 2016, is put up to Frederick Micheal Ahearn Jr; the other thirty fit nobody
the whole file and the surname's rows both kept on the run

steps.say: the 1950 census household step on Raymond Earl Davidson, run through the real census connector: the site's search and the schedule's transcription played back, the page image refused

answers.error: the harness's stand-in for no answer: timed out

expect.why: the transcription is the record and the run is found though the image did not come; the refusal is on the run, not in place of it
the record is the archive's own schedule, byte for byte
the search's response and the schedule kept, the image not

notes.has: the same page, fetched for Raymond Earl Davidson

expect.why: the father's step is held by the page fetched for his son

notes.has: the same page, fetched for Raymond Earl Davidson
